purpose: Emphasize the exact person, time, or thing that matters.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
express feelings speak politely show respect
This year, I really want to pass the exam.
It is I who should thank you.
It is precisely when we are in trouble that we should think calmly.
restrictions: Often marks a contrast with other candidates or a previous failed attempt.
mistake: こそ adds focus; it does not by itself mean only.
